audit.whatIsWrong: The entry says the blind is worthless here: 'your Blinding Shot does nothing to him — he deals zero damage with basic attacks' (content.early) and 'your Blinding Shot cannot punish him because all his damage comes from abilities, not autos' (whys[0]).
audit.why: Short Fuse is a periodic empowered basic attack, and the wiki's own note reads: 'Short Fuse will go on cooldown but not deal any damage if the attack misses due to blind.' So a well-timed dart does not merely whiff — it burns the charge outright and puts the passive on cooldown for nothing. In a lane where Ziggs uses Short Fuse autos to shove the wave and chip plates, denying that charge is the one piece of agency the blind still has.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart eats a Short Fuse charge: no damage, and the passive still goes on cooldown. That is what the blind is for in this lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range gap is given as '~200 units' in spikes[0] and whys[3], measured against 'your E poison auto'.
audit.why: Teemo's basic attack range is 500 and Bouncing Bomb is 850 — a 350-unit gap, not 200. Blinding Dart itself only reaches 680, so he out-ranges your dart by 170 as well, and even his basic attack range of 550 beats your 500. Understating the gap by 150 units is the difference between a walk-up that works and one that eats a bomb.
audit.corrected: Bouncing Bomb 850 vs your 500 attack range and 680 dart range; his autos reach 550 to your 500.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] and content.early call Teemo's passive 'camouflage'.
audit.why: Guerrilla Warfare grants Invisibility after 1.5 seconds standing still, not Camouflage. Camouflage is revealed by any nearby enemy; Invisibility is not. Against a Ziggs whose entire plan is to keep you at 850 units, the fact that he cannot reveal you by walking past your bush is exactly why the ambush is your only initiation.
audit.corrected: Guerrilla Warfare is Invisibility after 1.5s without moving — proximity does not reveal it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer carries a cooldown number, and content.late says 'split-push only when his R is on cooldown' without saying how long that is.
audit.why: Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16 seconds at every rank, Satchel Charge is 20s down to 12s, Bouncing Bomb is 6s down to 4s, and Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70. Your dart is a flat 7 seconds and your blind lasts 2s at rank 1 rising to 3s at rank 5. The actionable line is that his E is the long one: a spent minefield is a 16-second corridor you can actually cross.
audit.corrected: E is a flat 16s — that is your crossing window. W 20s->12s, R 120/95/70 decides when you may split.

audit.why: Teemo loses this lane at 47.16% over 405 games and the level chart gives Ziggs five of seven stages with one Skill and one Teemo. That is honest and matches the data — no change proposed.

edits.before: Ziggs's Q out-ranges your auto-attack by a wide margin, and your Blinding Shot does nothing to him — he deals zero damage with basic attacks, so the entire cornerstone of your trade pattern is irrelevant. Stand at max E-poison range and take whatever poke you must to hit the minion wave; do not charge toward him because his W will knock you back into his E minefield, losing the trade decisively. Your only early agency is Guerrilla Warfare: go invisible in a side bush when his Q is on cooldown and force him to either commit W (burning it) or let you auto him once.
edits.after: Ziggs's Q reaches 850 against your 500 attack range, and he out-autos you too at 550 — so the entire cornerstone of your trade pattern is spacing you cannot win. Blinding Dart is not dead weight though: Short Fuse is an empowered basic attack, and a blinded one deals no damage and still goes on cooldown, so the dart denies his auto-poke and his plate chip. Stand at max range and take whatever poke you must to hit the wave; do not charge him, because W knocks you back into his E minefield. Your other agency is Guerrilla Warfare invisibility — sit in a side bush when his Q is down and force him to burn W or eat an auto.

Your shrooms also deny his jungler the clean gank paths Ziggs loves to set up with E minefields at his flanks.

notes: Biggest fix: the entry twice told the reader that Blinding Dart is useless into Ziggs. The wiki's Short Fuse note is explicit — 'Short Fuse will go on cooldown but not deal any damage if the attack misses due to blind' — so a dart on his empowered auto denies the damage AND burns the charge. Second: the range gap was understated. Verified numbers are Teemo attack range 500, Blinding Dart 680, blind duration 2s to 3s; Ziggs attack range 550, Q 850, W 1000, E 900. So the auto-range gap is 350, not the ~200 the entry claimed. Also flagging a data defect: _missing-interactions.json lists 'Ziggs bypasses stacking resistances (Satchel Charge (W))' and the kit file carries a percentHealth flag on W; Satchel Charge's only percent-health text in Riot's description concerns hexploding vulnerable turrets, so that flag looks like a false positive and nothing in this proposal relies on it.
